<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2?thread=cmsg_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2ANG8z1sQ4781ggL7ayVKz3)_

**Base: `main`.** #415, #418 and #500 are merged; this PR is next, then #420 and #421. Docs, README and file moves only; no code logic changes.

## Update 2026-11-15 (merge of `main`)

- `main` merged `sp-devonthink-search` into `sp-devonthink-browse` (#500), so the search doc and module stay deleted; the merged `sp-devonthink-browse.org` is `main`'s, now in `docs/tangles/devonthink/`.
- `main` took ADR 0027 (centered miniframe), so the DEVONthink ADRs are renumbered **0028 to 0032** (files, titles, links, `adr/README.org`).
- `sp-devonthink.org` keeps `main`'s "Current state" and this PR's "Design"; the intro says "Current state" wins where they differ.
- Links from `sp-devonthink.org` to docs that stay in `academic/` now use `../academic/`.
- Not run (no Emacs in the cloud): `tools/check-tangle.sh` and the ERT tests; run them on the Mac.

## Merge order

- #420 and #421 are stacked on this branch; do not rename it.
- #421 mentions "ADR 0030" in `sp-devonthink-sync.org`; it now means ADR 0031 (two-way litnote and record link).
- A later change to a DEVONthink doc in `docs/tangles/academic/` (from any other PR) would need the same move.

## What

- `docs/architecture/devonthink-emacs-integration.org` is deleted; its content is a bullet-point "Design" section of `sp-devonthink.org`, with a status table and an "Open questions" list.
- The "Design" section links the old document at its last commit ([`c0188a9f`](https://github.com/siainbuletin/dotfiles/commit/c0188a9f0b7c1840034707d3866582a5000eeea3), 2026-11-08) and says how to print it with `git show`.
- New folder `docs/tangles/devonthink/` holds the DEVONthink docs, moved out of `docs/tangles/academic/`: `sp-devonthink`, `-tags`, `-browse`, `-bibsync`, `devonthink-move` and `devonthink-reading`. The `.el` files stay in `libraries/modules/academic/`; tangle paths are unchanged.
- Fixed after the move: `Literate source:` comments, `Tangled from` lines of `tools/devonthink-*.py`, tangle commands in the tool docs, links from `sp-litdb`, `sp-fetch-inbox`, `sp-academic`, `sp-org-lint` and two architecture docs.
- `README.org`: every DEVONthink row of the `academic/` table links to `docs/tangles/devonthink/`.
- Five ADRs listed in `adr/README.org`: 0028 citekey joins BibTeX/litnote/DEVONthink; 0029 DEVONthink only through its scripting interface; 0030 litdb indexes only highlighted pages; 0031 two-way litnote and record link (proposed); 0032 the small `reading` database.
- Generated `dotfiles-prs/` and the CHANGELOG are untouched.

## Manual testing

- [ ] `ls ~/.config/emacs-modular/docs/tangles/devonthink/` shows the DEVONthink docs (no `sp-devonthink-search.org`), and `ls docs/tangles/academic | grep -i devonthink` shows nothing.
- [ ] Open `docs/tangles/devonthink/sp-devonthink.org`: "Design" and "Current state" are both there; the old-document links open on GitHub.
- [ ] `C-c C-o` on each of the five ADR links in the Design intro: each ADR opens (0028 to 0032); `adr/README.org` lists 0027 to 0032.
- [ ] Follow the "Design:" link at the top of `sp-devonthink-tags.org`, `-browse.org`, and in `sp-litdb.org` and `devonthink-reading.org`: each lands in `sp-devonthink.org`.
- [ ] README: in the `academic/` table, the "Literate doc" link of each `sp-devonthink*` row opens its file in `docs/tangles/devonthink/`.
- [ ] `cd ~/.config/emacs-modular; bash tools/check-tangle.sh` gives "All tangled modules match their docs."

## Revert guide

- The move is one commit ("Move the DEVONthink docs to docs/tangles/devonthink and link the old design document"): `git revert` it to put the docs back in `docs/tangles/academic/`.
- The design merge and the ADRs are in an earlier commit and do not depend on the move.
